## Checklist

- [ ] `swift test` passes
- [ ] `swiftlint lint --strict` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has tests, and a bug fix has a test that fails without it
- [ ] Public API has documentation comments, and new options have default values
- [ ] `Documentation/` and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Snapshots are re-recorded if the appearance changed, with before and after screenshots above
